human_reorganization: The finite fourth moment is reconstructed with independent sign coordinates rather than the formal successor recurrence.
The weak-limit exclusion uses a compactly supported continuous cutoff rather than formal Prokhorov compact-range tightness.

Formal polygonal paths are continuous on R with compact-open topology. The paper explicitly proves the restricted C([0,1];C) uniform-topology result from the endpoint law. The general continuous-coordinate implication is a classical deduction.
The fixed-test result after every divergent reindexing is a direct classical deduction from the verified eventual exponent lower bound, not a new named Lean theorem.
The elementary sine lower bound is the human proof of the formal trigonometric bound; no optimal escape constant is asserted.
Taylor O(x^8) is an elementary series strengthening used in the exposition; the formal limit only needs its mapped o(x^4) remainder.

The arbitrary cyclic finite character basis is normalized with conjugate Fourier coefficients. The actual four-mark powers use r=1,2,3, whereas source Fin 3 index is r-1. Positive Gram weights are (2a^2)^r, while the holomorphic fourth moment is -4a^4; these are not interchangeable.

The original infinite product and its prefix filtration support coherent finite, L1/almost-sure and full L2 reconstruction. Infinite square energy is only asserted in the L2 case. The integrand quotient norm is induced by the actual integration range and identified with energy; surjectivity is proved before completeness.

The bounded adjoint of the completed predictable integration isometry is the reconstruction derivative in this paper. It is not identified with an unbounded anticipating Malliavin derivative or a signed pseudoprocess operator.

The cylinder-density and maximal-inequality proof reorganizes the verified conditional-limit mechanism into a complete human argument. Finite all-time common versions use countably many prefixes. The real sign-coordinate basis comparison is an elementary human deduction.

The unit exponential source has actual finite count and marked paths. Its nonexplosion and residual-life factorization are reconstructed directly. The displayed wall-clock Dynkin/channel identity is the actual combined martingale, not a full continuous-time PRP for arbitrary holding/mark terminal variables.

Centered mark kernels have zero mark mean and therefore cannot equal a unit count jump for every mark. This explicit obstruction is not a claim that a four-channel continuous-time representation is impossible. Mark-source Hilbert isometry is not transferred to time components, signed targets or an ordinary weak scaling limit.
